responsibility: Implements GCC’s RTL global redundancy elimination framework, including partial redundancy elimination (PRE) when optimizing for speed and code hoisting when optimizing for size, along with supporting expression discovery, dataflow, load/store-motion preparation, and profitability/expense checks. It coordinates CFG cleanup, DF analysis, expression handling via REG_EQUAL and set patterns, and pass-level policy such as rerunning later CSE, and registers the main RTL passes "rtl pre" and "hoist".
same_name_distinction: Implements the main RTL GCSE/PRE/hoisting passes and their pass registration, whereas gcc/gcse.h exposes only supporting shared state and utility declarations. This .cc file contains the optimization algorithms, profitability checks, CFG/dataflow orchestration, and the 'rtl pre' and 'hoist' pass definitions rather than just the module interface.
